text: For a parameterized game, the authors pick a number of oversight steps n and play a chain of games in which each Guard faces a Houdini whose general Elo is Delta_general/n higher, the previous Houdini becoming the next Guard, and seek the n* that maximizes the product of the stepwise Guard win probabilities.
title: NSO model: n oversight games with Elo steps of Delta_general/n, success = product of wins
